scoring_justification: The spin-wave model is fully specified; the checker can independently recompute all eigenvalues and compare directly with the agent's output.

outputs.description: List of all positive magnon eigenvalues for each k-point and branch index. At least 20 k-points must be included. The recomputation ignores dipolar interactions (ω_M=0).

output_contract.notes: The checker implements the same spin-wave model (exchange + anisotropy, no dipolar) and recomputes eigenvalues on the same k-grid, then compares the agent's values via RMS deviation and branch structure checks. No external hidden holdout is needed, only the derived numerical reference.

steps.description: Recompute spin-wave eigenvalues and compare with agent's values
